variations.name: Standard
variations.description: One whole office day for 300 employees, from 06:45 to about 20:00. People arrive from about 07:00 (some late), go to lunch around 12:00 (some leave the building, some only visit the cafeteria on the lobby floor), make meeting and break trips, and mostly go home from 17:00 (some stay late). Expect three peaks (morning, lunch, evening) with quiet stretches between. Energy is a comparative estimate. This scenario runs on the live engine only.
